name: 63 - API - Manage Clinical Question Templates - Standalone Final

parameters.query:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT
    $1::TEXT action, NULLIF($2::TEXT,'') clinic_name, $3::TEXT scope,
    NULLIF($4::BIGINT,0) template_id, $5::TEXT symptom_category,
    NULLIF($6::TEXT,'') question_code, NULLIF($7::TEXT,'') question_text_fa,
    NULLIF($8::TEXT,'') question_text_en, NULLIF($9::TEXT,'') question_text_ar,
    $10::TEXT answer_type, $11::JSONB options_json, $12::BOOLEAN required,
    NULLIF($13::TEXT,'') maps_to_case_field, $14::TEXT risk_if_true,
    $15::INTEGER sort_order, $16::BOOLEAN active, $17::JSONB bulk_items
),
c AS (
  SELECT clinics.id clinic_id
  FROM clinics, r
  WHERE clinics.name = r.clinic_name AND clinics.is_active = TRUE
  LIMIT 1
),
ctx AS (
  SELECT r.*, CASE WHEN scope='global' THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT clinic_id FROM c) END target_clinic_id
  FROM r
),
created AS (
  INSERT INTO clinical_intake_question_templates (
    clinic_id,symptom_category,question_code,question_text_fa,question_text_en,
    question_text_ar,answer_type,options_json,required,maps_to_case_field,
    risk_if_true,active,sort_order
  )
  SELECT target_clinic_id,symptom_category,question_code,question_text_fa,
         question_text_en,question_text_ar,answer_type,options_json,required,
         maps_to_case_field,risk_if_true,active,sort_order
  FROM ctx
  WHERE action='create' AND (scope='global' OR target_clinic_id IS NOT NULL)
  RETURNING *
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE clinical_intake_question_templates t
  SET symptom_category=ctx.symptom_category,
      question_code=COALESCE(ctx.question_code,t.question_code),
      question_text_fa=COALESCE(ctx.question_text_fa,t.question_text_fa),
      question_text_en=ctx.question_text_en,
      question_text_ar=ctx.question_text_ar,
      answer_type=ctx.answer_type,options_json=ctx.options_json,
      required=ctx.required,maps_to_case_field=ctx.maps_to_case_field,
      risk_if_true=ctx.risk_if_true,sort_order=ctx.sort_order,
      active=ctx.active,updated_at=NOW()
  FROM ctx
  WHERE ctx.action='update' AND t.id=ctx.template_id
    AND ((ctx.scope='global' AND t.clinic_id IS NULL)
      OR (ctx.scope='clinic' AND t.clinic_id=ctx.target_clinic_id))
  RETURNING t.*
),
status_changed AS (
  UPDATE clinical_intake_question_templates t
  SET active=(ctx.action='activate'),updated_at=NOW()
  FROM ctx
  WHERE ctx.action IN ('activate','deactivate') AND t.id=ctx.template_id
    AND ((ctx.scope='global' AND t.clinic_id IS NULL)
      OR (ctx.scope='clinic' AND t.clinic_id=ctx.target_clinic_id))
  RETURNING t.*
),
bulk_rows AS (
  SELECT ctx.target_clinic_id,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(i->>'symptom_category',''),'general') symptom_category,
         i->>'question_code' question_code,
         i->>'question_text_fa' question_text_fa,
         NULLIF(i->>'question_text_en','') question_text_en,
         NULLIF(i->>'question_text_ar','') question_text_ar,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(i->>'answer_type',''),'boolean') answer_type,
         COALESCE(i->'options_json','[]'::JSONB) options_json,
         COALESCE((i->>'required')::BOOLEAN,TRUE) required,
         NULLIF(i->>'maps_to_case_field','') maps_to_case_field,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(i->>'risk_if_true',''),'none') risk_if_true,
         COALESCE((i->>'active')::BOOLEAN,TRUE) active,
         COALESCE((i->>'sort_order')::INTEGER,100) sort_order
  FROM ctx CROSS JOIN LATERAL JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(ctx.bulk_items) i
  WHERE ctx.action='bulk_upsert' AND (ctx.scope='global' OR ctx.target_clinic_id IS NOT NULL)
),
bulk_updated AS (
  UPDATE clinical_intake_question_templates t
  SET question_text_fa=b.question_text_fa,question_text_en=b.question_text_en,
      question_text_ar=b.question_text_ar,answer_type=b.answer_type,
      options_json=b.options_json,required=b.required,
      maps_to_case_field=b.maps_to_case_field,risk_if_true=b.risk_if_true,
      active=b.active,sort_order=b.sort_order,updated_at=NOW()
  FROM bulk_rows b
  WHERE t.clinic_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.target_clinic_id
    AND LOWER(t.symptom_category)=LOWER(b.symptom_category)
    AND t.question_code=b.question_code
  RETURNING t.id
),
bulk_inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO clinical_intake_question_templates (
    clinic_id,symptom_category,question_code,question_text_fa,question_text_en,
    question_text_ar,answer_type,options_json,required,maps_to_case_field,
    risk_if_true,active,sort_order
  )
  SELECT b.target_clinic_id,b.symptom_category,b.question_code,b.question_text_fa,
         b.question_text_en,b.question_text_ar,b.answer_type,b.options_json,
         b.required,b.maps_to_case_field,b.risk_if_true,b.active,b.sort_order
  FROM bulk_rows b
  WHERE b.question_code IS NOT NULL AND b.question_text_fa IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM clinical_intake_question_templates t
      WHERE t.clinic_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.target_clinic_id
        AND LOWER(t.symptom_category)=LOWER(b.symptom_category)
        AND t.question_code=b.question_code
    )
  RETURNING id
),
listed AS (
  SELECT t.id,t.clinic_id,cl.name clinic_name,
         CASE WHEN t.clinic_id IS NULL THEN 'global' ELSE 'clinic' END scope,
         t.symptom_category,t.question_code,t.question_text_fa,t.question_text_en,
         t.question_text_ar,t.answer_type,t.options_json,t.required,
         t.maps_to_case_field,t.risk_if_true,t.active,t.sort_order,
         t.created_at,t.updated_at
  FROM clinical_intake_question_templates t
  LEFT JOIN clinics cl ON cl.id=t.clinic_id
  CROSS JOIN ctx
  WHERE ctx.action='list'
    AND ((ctx.scope='global' AND t.clinic_id IS NULL)
      OR (ctx.scope='clinic' AND (t.clinic_id=ctx.target_clinic_id OR t.clinic_id IS NULL)))
    AND (ctx.symptom_category='all' OR LOWER(t.symptom_category)=LOWER(ctx.symptom_category))
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.clinic_id=ctx.target_clinic_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
           t.symptom_category,t.sort_order,t.id
  LIMIT 500
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN r.scope='clinic' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c) THEN FALSE
    WHEN r.action='create' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM created) THEN FALSE
    WHEN r.action='update' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM updated) THEN FALSE
    WHEN r.action IN ('activate','deactivate') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM status_changed) THEN FALSE
    ELSE TRUE
  END success,
  CASE
    WHEN r.scope='clinic' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c) THEN 'clinic_not_found'
    WHEN r.action='create' THEN 'clinical_question_template_created'
    WHEN r.action='update' THEN 'clinical_question_template_updated'
    WHEN r.action='activate' THEN 'clinical_question_template_activated'
    WHEN r.action='deactivate' THEN 'clinical_question_template_deactivated'
    WHEN r.action='bulk_upsert' THEN 'clinical_question_templates_bulk_upserted'
    ELSE 'clinical_question_templates_listed'
  END result,
  COALESCE((SELECT JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(listed)) FROM listed),'[]'::JSONB) templates,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bulk_updated),0)+COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bulk_inserted),0) bulk_affected_count,
  COALESCE((SELECT id FROM created),(SELECT id FROM updated),(SELECT id FROM status_changed)) template_id
FROM r;

parameters.content:
## مدیریت سؤالات تخصصی

اقدام‌ها: create, update, activate, deactivate, list, bulk_upsert

scope=clinic برای سؤال اختصاصی و scope=global برای الگوی عمومی است.
